version.description: The version of this file format

stock.description: How much of each good a trader keeps

minimumCap.description: A trader never restocks a good beyond max(its starting stock * capFactor, this)

capFactor.description: The cap on a stock is its target times this, in percent

defaultTarget.description: The target of a good the trader's profile does not stock

catchUpDays.description: After a long absence at most this many days of deliveries arrive at once

curve.description: How the price follows the stock: the price at an empty and a full store

minPercent.description: The price at a full store, in percent of the base price

maxPercent.description: The price at an empty store, in percent of the base price

percentPerTrade.description: How far one trade moves the price, in percent

maxPercent.description: The most a price can drift from its base, in percent

decayPercentPerDay.description: How much of a price drift fades each day, in percent

reputation.description: How a trader treats people by what it thinks of them

percent.description: The price a trader asks, in percent, by attitude

friendly.description: Price in percent for a friend

neutral.description: Price in percent for a stranger

wary.description: Price in percent for someone it is wary of

scared.description: Price in percent for someone it fears

suspicious.description: Price in percent for someone it distrusts

enchanted.description: Price in percent for someone it is enchanted by

lovingly.description: Price in percent for someone it loves

enviously.description: Price in percent for someone it envies

refuse.description: The attitudes a trader will not deal with at all

wants.description: How strongly a trader wants what it lacks

wantPercent.description: The price in percent for goods it wants

otherPercent.description: The price in percent for goods it does not want

haggle.description: Haggle (D-54 Q5): one try per trader per in-game day, a seeded roll of the world seed, the trader and the day; a win is a discount for the rest of the day, a loss costs opinion. `persuasion` is the hero's Trade affinity divided by 10.

baseChance.description: Base chance in percent that haggling works

opinionDivisor.description: Opinion is divided by this to add to the chance

perPersuasion.description: Chance gained for each point of persuasion, in percent

minChance.description: The worst chance haggling can have, in percent

maxChance.description: The best chance haggling can reach, in percent

discountPercent.description: The discount a successful haggle gives, in percent

purse.description: US-283: what it can pay out in a currency region, in value units

start.description: The money a trader starts with

restockPerDay.description: Money a trader gains each day

cap.description: The most money a trader holds
